## Problem description

A clear and concise description of the problem or the missing capability.
For example: "As an editor I cannot ... because ...".

## Desired solution

A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps to understand the request, for example links to the
HIS documentation, screenshots or example configuration.
